lines.1: 「But it feels like such a waste to give up. The chicken ribs... the chicken ribs.」
lines.2: 「You were scared of her too, weren't you?」
lines.3: 「Sure, she kind of has the same vibe as my sister, and that's scary.」
lines.4: 「But she's gorgeous enough to make up for it, and this is my chance to overcome my trauma.」
lines.5: 「Besides, if things go well, I might even get close to her!」
lines.6: 「A great man who set a new major-league record once said...」
lines.9: 「No way it's zero! As long as I'm alive, it can never be zero!」
lines.10: Wait. Was that actually kind of profound?
lines.12: 「But I... I want to touch a girl...」
lines.14: Such a naked cry from the heart.
lines.15: He had absolutely nothing left to lose.
lines.16: 「And ideally, she'd be gorgeous and stacked. That girl's a little tall, but she qualifies. She's as beautiful as a tropical fish!」
lines.17: 「More like a porcupinefish. She's covered in spikes.」
lines.18: 「Then if she were a flower, she'd be a rose.」
lines.19: 「Never heard that every rose has its thorn?」
lines.20: 「Besides, I just remembered something about you... You know, that thing?」
